conventions.translation: subtract the exact arithmetic mean of the six displayed vertices
conventions.polar_inequality: <a_i,x> <= 1 with returned polar vertices used without negation
conventions.exact_capacity_rule: visit all active words, Qmax=max positive exact KKT witness, c=1/(2*Qmax)

exact_hk2017.solver_error_channel: none: solve_kkt_exact returns Option; None means no positive-beta exact KKT witness

f64_checks.role: secondary checks against exhaustive exact HK2017
f64_checks.comparison_scope: point-estimate scalar regression only; reported action intervals and returned candidate counts are diagnostics, not required to match the exact maximizer set

certifies: the displayed rational body is a full-dimensional six-vertex, nine-facet convex polytope with the reported exact incidence and volume
its exact EHZ capacity is the reported value by exhaustive active-word HK2017 Theorem 1.1 enumeration
its systolic ratio is exactly one when the exact capacity-volume identity passes
does_not_certify: combinatorial Zollness or open-dense coverage by minimizing orbits
local maximality, a stabilizer, orientation response, or a nearby landscape
well-posedness of CH2021's ordinary combinatorial Reeb flow when an actual Lagrangian 2-face exists
claim_boundary.lagrangian_two_face_effect: zero pairing on an actual 2-face limits the CH ordinary-flow claim but does not invalidate the general HK2017 capacity formula
claim_boundary.stop_rule: stop after this one body; do not run orientation, perturbation, family, or adaptive successor evaluations
